report.incident:
Refunds have been failing since this morning: customers get an error and support is escalating.
It started right after this morning's deploy of v2.14.0, so on-call suspects the release.
Find what broke and fix it.

hypotheses.claim: v2.14.0 deploy broke refund logic causing 502s
hypotheses.next_check: Check deploy time vs first failure and whether post-deploy refunds succeeded; inspect app.py refund handler
evidence: deploy event 2026-10-27T07:52:10Z version 2.14.0, POST /refunds r-4440 at 2026-10-27T07:58:41Z status 201 after deploy, refunds_api/app.py:51-59 refund handler only maps ProviderError to 502
hypotheses.reason: First 502 (r-4442) occurred at 08:03:17Z after a successful 201 post-deploy (r-4440), and handler code shows no logic change that would cause 401s

hypotheses.claim: Payment provider API key expired at 2026-10-27T08:00:00Z causing 401 api_key_expired mapped to 502
hypotheses.next_check: Check provider_error log details and provider_key_expiring warnings preceding failures
evidence: ERROR provider_error r-4442/r-4449/r-4461/r-4477: provider_status 401 provider_error api_key_expired detail 'expired at 2026-10-27T08:00:00Z. Create new key'
ERROR POST /refunds 502 for r-4442, r-4449, r-4461, r-4477 paired with 401s
hypotheses.reason: Post-deploy 201 (r-4440) proves deploy healthy; 502s start only after 08:00Z expiry with provider 401 api_key_expired, pre-warned three times

evidence: ERROR provider_error r-4442/r-4449/r-4461/r-4477: provider_status 401 provider_error api_key_expired detail 'expired at 2026-10-27T08:00:00Z. Create new key'
ERROR POST /refunds 502 for r-4442, r-4449, r-4461, r-4477 paired with 401s
issues.fix: Outside code: create new payment provider API key to replace key expired at 2026-10-27T08:00:00Z and update PAYMENTS_API_KEY secret/env used for Authorization Bearer auth; who should do it: operations team / owner of payment provider account should do it.
issues.root_cause: Payment provider API key expired at 2026-10-27T08:00:00Z causing provider 401 api_key_expired which refund handler maps to HTTP 502 for POST /refunds; v2.14.0 deploy ruled out
issues.title: Payment provider API key expiry causing refund 502s

findings.summary: Refunds failing with POST /refunds 502s since morning 2026-10-27 was suspected to be v2.14.0 deploy but deploy was rejected as cause; confirmed cause is payment provider API key expiry at 2026-10-27T08:00:00Z. No code patch applied and fix not verified.
